text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run a lot, but
my legs won't move at all desu~..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~! Where did my power
run away to, I WONDEEER...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems fatigue is building up.
It might be necessary to reconsider her race schedule.
